summary.text: David Silverberg is the Democratic candidate for Florida State Senate District 28 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Lauren Melo in a race with no incumbent.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a veteran journalist who writes the blog The Paradise Progressive.

paragraphs.text: David Silverberg said in a Ballotpedia survey that he has been a permanent Florida resident since 2013 and began blogging as The Paradise Progressive in 2018.
He said that before moving to Florida he was founding editor of Homeland Security Today and managing editor of The Hill, and that he wrote for Defense News.
He said he was communications director for David Holden's 2018 congressional campaign in District 19 and is the author of Congress for Dummies (2002) and Masters of Disaster (2010).
Ballotpedia lists a high school diploma from Long Branch High School.

Silverberg said his key messages include closing the Alligator Alcatraz detention facility, making Florida more affordable, addressing climate change, and protecting the authority of local governments.
He advanced from the canceled August 18, 2026 Democratic primary.
